title: KernelProbeRequest
description: The `-Prequest=` input of `./gradlew :adapter:kernelProbe`: one document model plus one or more named documents to observe the REAL kernel's runtime validation over. Relative `model`/`document` references resolve against THIS FILE'S directory, so a request and its inputs form one movable bundle. The probe grows no authoring surface: the model is authored with dmtool's structured verbs (`rule add`, `computation add`, …) and passed here already complete, self-contained, and expanded — it is loaded exactly as the kernel's own deserializer does, with no reference resolution, so an unexpanded model is refused. The normative contract is docs/KERNEL-PROBE-SPEC.md.

model.description: path to the DM-JSON document model, relative to this request file or absolute. A model the kernel's consistency oracle reports an ERROR on is REFUSED with those diagnostics rather than evaluated — an inconsistent model would otherwise observe nothing at all, which reads as 'nothing fired'.

locale.description: the evaluation locale, in A12's `language_COUNTRY` form. It MUST be one the model DECLARES: the kernel refuses any other outright (`Locale 'en_US' is not supported in the document model '…'`, measured 2026-08-11), so a German-only model needs `de_DE` here rather than merely producing English text. Only the `message` channel is locale-dependent; `code`, `type`, `severity`, and every address are not.

clock.description: an ISO-8601 instant pinning the kernel's `currentDateForTest` (both Today and Now) on BOTH strategies. Required for a byte-reproducible artifact whenever any rule reads the current date; omitted, the real clock is used and only clock-independent models reproduce.

rows.description: the ordered observations. Each row's document is evaluated on every kernel strategy; the artifact keeps the row order.

name.description: this observation's identity in the artifact; must be unique within the request

document.description: path to an A12 canonical Document JSON instance, relative to this request file or absolute — the same shape `dmtool model seed` writes and `model eval --instance` reads (schema `document-instance.schema.json`), so one document file feeds both the interpreter and this probe. Exactly one of `document` / `documentInline` is required.

documentInline.description: the A12 canonical Document JSON embedded directly, for a self-contained single-file request. Exactly one of `document` / `documentInline` is required.
